title: Design: Long category names show in full in the No Charge chip's tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new No Charge category for this test, category B, with "Requires the original work order" unticked, whose name is 60 characters long with no spaces (for example PlainsviewCompanyVehicleHeavyEquipmentMaintenanceNorthRegion).
  • Have a new No Charge category for this test, category C, with "Requires the original work order" unticked, whose name has the characters & " ' < > (for example Plainsview "Yard" & O'Neil <Units> Upkeep).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, not flagged.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, billable, not invoiced, whose line 1 has a long title with spaces (for example Replace front and rear brake chambers, slack adjusters and every air line) and is marked No Charge under category B, and whose line 2 has a title with the characters & " ' < > (for example Brakes & "Air" O'Neil <Kit>) and is marked No Charge under category C.
  • The category Name field takes 60 characters at most; if it refuses one of the characters & " ' < >, leave that character out and write down which.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow6-03-03-line-marked-no-charge-0-00-v14.png, iwo-flow6-04-04-line-menu-change-category-mark-as-billable-v14.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Hover over the "No Charge" chip on line 1.
  3. Hover over the "No Charge" chip on line 2.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 1 and line 2 each show the chip "No Charge" next to their titles.
  • Each chip shows only the words "No Charge", with no category name in it.
  • Each title and its chip stay inside the Name/Description cell; neither runs over Actual/Estimate.
  • On both lines Actual/Estimate, Status, Rate ($0.00), Total ($0.00) and the three-dots menu are visible.
  • Each name shows exactly as you typed it: the characters & " ' < > show as typed, not as "&" or other codes.

Step 2:

  • A tooltip reads "Category: [category B's name]" with the whole name: nothing is cut off and the tooltip stays inside the browser window.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip reads "Category: [category C's name]", inside the browser window.
  • The category name shows exactly as you typed it: the characters & " ' < > show as typed, not as "&" or other codes.

Step 4:

  • Each chip still reads "No Charge" and stays inside the Name/Description cell; every column and the three-dots menus are visible.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.4 (13 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R3: “A no-charge line shows the chip "No Charge" next to its title on the lines table, in Tech View and on mobile, with the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, as the work order badge has (S2-R16); the category itself is not printed in the chip; Rate, Total and every part on it show $0.00; Margin shows nothing. Hours, technician, status, approval, parts ordering, picking, receiving, clock-ins, notes, inspections and the story work as on any line. The original work order and line are not shown on the line; they are in the notes, the Audit Log, the report and the hub record.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794565397-7f4c (read and rendered 14 Nov 2026: from version 1794561577-f903 one string changed, the chip of a no-charge line now reads "No Charge" on 6 boards; the other 161 boards are pixel-identical): page "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order", boards "03 Line marked No Charge · $0.00" (Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order), "04 Line menu · Change category, Mark as Billable" (Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow6-03-03-line-marked-no-charge-0-00-v14.png
  • iwo-flow6-04-04-line-menu-change-category-mark-as-billable-v14.png

The design draws this place with short names only. These results check that its layout holds with long and unusual names; where the PRD says nothing about the look, the pictures are the source.

Register IWO-N45 on S12-R3 (design silent): the boards draw the chip "No Charge" but no tooltip; PRD v1.4 S12-R3 states the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, so this case follows the PRD.
